title: SiteBuild canonical site spec
description: The decoded factual site specification accepted by SiteBuilder::createProject(siteSpec: ...) and emitted as siteSpec.json. The fixed fields describe identity, subject, language, homepage scope, and the page tree. Additional top-level properties are allowed for grounded facts such as hours, location, services, or social links; design decisions do not belong here.

name.description: Short, masthead-friendly brand or site name.

title.description: Main site title or visitor-facing headline.

description.description: One factual sentence describing the site and what it offers.

site_type.description: Kind of site, for example business storefront, blog, portfolio, menu, or landing page.

topic.description: What the site is about, in one short phrase.

language.description: Language for all generated copy. Prefer a BCP-47 code such as en or es-AR. An empty normalized value means downstream steps follow the prompt language.

writing_direction.description: Normalized logical writing direction derived from a caller override or the site language.

persona_name.description: Full name for the person represented by a personal site; empty for non-personal sites.

email_domain.description: Lowercase bare domain the user stated for contact; empty when none was given. Never invented. No @ sign or URL scheme.

invented.description: Identity fields invented because the source prompt did not state them. Contact facts are never invented.

visual_vibe.description: Brief overall mood phrase, without concrete colors, fonts, spacing, or layout choices.

subject_is_visual_work.description: Whether the site's core offering is itself visual imagery, used to require an image-bearing hero composition.

animation_request.description: Verbatim specific motion behavior requested by the user; empty when none was requested.

sections.description: Ordered section hints for the homepage.

pages.description: Site page tree. The first top-level page is the homepage by position.

page.description: One page in the site tree. Slugs must be unique across the entire tree; generated specs normally stay at two levels, although the runtime accepts recursive children.

title.description: Short navigation title in the site language.

slug.description: Lowercase, URL-safe slug unique across the complete page tree.

purpose.description: What content belongs on this page so it does not overlap sibling pages.

children.description: Nested pages in the same canonical shape.
